note: Shipped reference profile (workflow plane, integrated composition). A small team running the lifecycle with a governance plane joined by exact semantic reference: this workflow profile's governance facet names its governance profile by identity, and --profile integrated-profile resolves the pair. Validated by validate-reference-profiles.ts; the named governance profile must exist in the governance library and pass the governance profile contract.
scope: A small team taking a change from discovery through acceptance and integration under a governance plane.
applicability: Trusted project repository with reviewed instructions and a selected governance profile.

topology.compositePresentation: Review = Review + QA; Integrate = Integration (explicit post-acceptance)

requiredInputs: Each capability resolves its inputs from the selected provider; Acceptance additionally consumes the governance evidence reference.
publicationBoundaries: Results publish to the selected provider; governance decision, enforcement, and evidence stay separate references.
exitRules: Acceptance exits only with the governance evidence its profile requires; Integration exits after an accepted deliverable.
completionEvidence: An accepted, integrated deliverable with preserved Review/QA results and the required governance evidence reference.
authorization: Acceptance is authorized by a distinct reviewer per the governance profile.
freshness: Acceptance binds to the exact native revision; governance evidence must be fresh per its profile.

governance.enforcementGuarantee: Every mandatory control binds to a supported, guaranteed enforcement point in the named governance profile.

failureBehavior: If the named governance profile is unavailable or a mandatory control has no guaranteed enforcement point, fail visibly; unselected modules remain explicit gaps, not hidden defaults.
absenceReport: Only the workflow and governance profiles selected here apply; anything unselected is an explicit gap.
